title: Remote execution v1 draft control models

grammarRevision.description: Optional for generic builds; required and pinned by injected media tool definitions.

sourceRevision.description: Optional for generic builds; required and pinned by injected media tool definitions.

runtimeEnvironment.description: Fixed native runtime environment; caller conflicts fail admission.

requiredFeatures.description: Required negotiated profiles, including canonical-object-v1 for byte namespace callbacks. Refuse before job effects if unsupported.

ranges.description: Optional narrowing to byte intervals. Validate start <= endExclusive and every access within an authorized interval; omission never widens host authority.

Descriptor.description: handleId leases a shell-admitted description; openDescriptionId correlates shared cursor, never file identity or native fd. fd/rights uniqueness and seekability checked before acquisition.

requiredFeatures.description: Required negotiated profiles, including canonical-object-v1 for byte namespace callbacks. Refuse before job effects if unsupported.

bytes.description: Legacy draft content field; prohibited by the streaming/canonical-object-v1 profile. Payloads belong in binary channels or authorized blobs.

FileMetadata.description: Legacy draft model. For canonical-object-v1 use companion WireExactFileStat and signed-off_t-compatible exact values; never round through Number.
